limits: Instrumentation adds 100 ms sampling, 5 second process discovery and a 16 ms heartbeat.
Event-loop lateness is not visual drag latency or animation FPS.
Sub-100 ms peaks and descendants shorter than 5 seconds may be missed; main lifetime peaks are separately reported.
Includes matching Windows venv launcher parent; excludes invoking shell.
No AI models or microphone. GPU/compositor memory not measured.
Working-set sum may count shared pages more than once.
